instruction:
Task: Click the 'Regenerate' button on an AI message.
Expected Result: A new version of the AI message is displayed, replacing the current one. All subsequent messages in the current branch are cleared. A generation selector (e.g., '1/2') appears below the AI message, indicating the current generation and total available.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
